info.description: Embed external content (Calendly, podcast players, maps, etc.)

title.description: Optional heading shown above the embed. Leave blank if the embedded content already has its own heading.

embed_code.description: Paste either (a) a URL — YouTube, Vimeo, Calendly, any iframe-able site — and the site will render it as an iframe; OR (b) raw HTML (e.g. an entire campaign page, a form snippet, a widget script) and the site will render it as-is. For a whole standalone HTML page with your own layout, prefer the Custom HTML Landing content type instead (it gives you a proper /campaigns/ URL and image tokens).

style.description: Optional background colour, text colour, padding, alignment, max width, and background image for this section. Leave any field blank to use defaults.
